summary: ITER136 P0 frontend-only testing of Expense Register + non-trip expense operator workflow via preview URL with demo login. All 11 requested flows executed with Playwright: sidebar nav-expenses (Telugu label 'ఖర్చులు (Expenses)'), /expenses register render (expense-register, kpi-count/kpi-total/kpi-reversed, filter row, 10-column table), New Expense drawer, standalone Insurance ₹18,000 create (no vehicle chip, vehicle cell '—'), edit to ₹18,500, short-reason (2 chars) cancel rejection, valid-reason soft-cancel removal, 'Show reversed' does not resurrect soft-deleted row, twin-payable guard (no vendor_bill_id / mechanic_work_order_id inputs), vehicle-linked Tyres ₹22,000 create with vehicle chip navigating to /vehicles/veh_c501e8a429754fbf/cost (Iter135A page loaded and reflected the ₹22,000 Tyres cost), and category filter (Insurance / Tyres). Zero console errors throughout. All core acceptance criteria PASS. One functional gap found: ExpenseForm has no party_name / party_id input, so the requested party_name='Local Tyre Co' could not be entered and the Party column shows the raw 'vendor' string.

ui_bugs.issue: No input for party_name (or party_id) even though both are kept in form state and sent in the POST/PUT payload (lines 43-44, 68-69). Operator selecting party_type=vendor/mechanic/supplier/driver cannot record WHO was paid; requested test case party_name='Local Tyre Co' was impossible via UI. Register Party column then displays the raw party_type token.

Party column renders unformatted lowercase party_type ('vendor') when party_name is empty; other tokens ('mechanic','supplier','driver') would render the same way. Should be title-cased/labelled like the drawer's PARTY_TYPES labels.

No pagination / page-size limit: default unfiltered load rendered 7881 rows in a single DOM table (KPI 'Rows 7881', total ₹21,35,004.00). Heavy DOM + full dataset transfer on every filter change; will degrade badly as data grows.

issues: Filter row uses raw browser date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar component used elsewhere
'Category' filter is a free-text box with placeholder 'Any' rather than a select of the 20 known ExpenseForm categories — operators must type the exact string (works, but discoverability/typo-prone)
Actions column buttons (Edit/Cancel) wrap to two lines at 1920px in the wide unfiltered table

action_items: Add a party_name text input (and optional party picker for party_id) to ExpenseForm, shown when party_type is not none/cash — currently the payload field is dead UI-wise.
Add pagination or a server-side limit/offset to GET /api/expenses consumption in ExpenseRegister (7881 rows rendered at once).
Format the Party column via the PARTY_TYPES label map instead of printing the raw enum token.
Optional: convert the Category filter free-text into a select seeded from the CATEGORIES list; remove unused imports (FileText, X) in ExpenseRegister.jsx and the no-op useEffect in ExpenseForm.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: ExpenseForm.jsx keeps party_name/party_id in state and sends them, but renders no control for either — silent data loss for vendor/mechanic expenses.

ExpenseRegister.jsx fetches the entire expense collection unbounded; KPIs (total/reversed) are computed client-side over that full array, so they will silently break/slow once paginated — move aggregates server-side.
ExpenseRegister.jsx imports FileText and X without using them; ExpenseForm.jsx has an empty useEffect on form.vehicle_id (dead code).

success_rate.frontend: 91% (10/11 flows fully pass; party_name sub-step of the Tyres case blocked by missing input)

seed_data_creation: Created and then hard-deleted two test expenses (Insurance 'Annual comprehensive insurance' and Tyres 'TEST Tyres set replacement'). IMPORTANT: during the first pass an existing seeded Insurance expense exp_3e96b9a440744b6b (veh_559d72e14b0a44ae / AP99IT2B6641) was edited to 18500 and soft-cancelled by the test; it has been fully restored in MongoDB (amount=12000.0, is_deleted=false, deletion_* fields unset) and verified. No other pre-existing data touched.
test_credentials: Demo login via [data-testid="demo-login-button"] on /login (works, lands on /dashboard as user_demo_men_2026, effective_role admin/owner so Cancel buttons render).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expense register default list is unsorted-by-recency-only and contains ~7.9k seeded rows with far-future dates (2029, 2077-2079). To find a newly created row, always set filter-from AND filter-to to today plus the category filter — otherwise tbody row 0 is a seeded row and edit/cancel will mutate seed data. Row action testids are edit-btn-<expense_id> / cancel-btn-<expense_id>; vehicle chip is row-vehicle-link-<vehicle_id>; the cancel flow uses window.prompt (handle with page.once('dialog', ...)).
rca_of_the_issue: Missing party_name input: ExpenseForm was built with the payload contract complete but the corresponding UI Field block was never added, so party attribution silently defaults to empty. Pagination gap: the register calls GET /api/expenses with only filter params and no limit, and derives KPIs from the returned array client-side.
